key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:37C8
name: offset_record_position_by_deltas
description: Adds the two 16-bit input values to two byte fields read from a record, and stores each sum as a 16-bit field in the same record. Nothing else is read or written.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:37E4
name: call_three_library_functions
description: Calls three Amiga OS library functions in sequence through jump offsets from the library base, then returns the two input words unchanged.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:38EC
name: initialize_handler_state
description: Stores two input arguments and a long list of default constants into global variables, then looks up the current task and allocates a signal through exec library calls. Several other routines are called to set handler pointers.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:39E8
name: call_handler_while_register_nonzero
description: Calls an indirect handler routine in a loop that continues while an input register holds a non-zero value. The pseudo-code shows no other reads or writes.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:39F6
name: process_port_messages_into_list
description: Takes messages from an exec message port in a loop and replies to each one. Most messages are copied into a newly allocated record that is appended to a global list, and the routine returns zero once the port is empty.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:3AB6
name: restore_saved_field_after_call
description: Calls a routine through a pointer at a fixed offset from a global base, then writes a saved 32-bit value back into a field of a structure reached through a global pointer.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:3ABA
name: free_signal_and_restore_field
description: Calls an exec library function at a fixed offset to free a signal, then writes a saved 32-bit value back into a field of a structure reached through a global pointer.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:3B2A
name: dispatch_tagged_record_entry
description: Returns early unless a 16-bit tag in the record matches a fixed value. Records with a zero key advance a string cursor, and other records clear matching entries in a linked list before saving, clearing and restoring several fields around a nested call.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:3BA0
name: save_restore_record_around_call
description: For records whose low two type bits are zero or one, saves four fields, marks the record busy, calls a routine and then restores the saved fields. Other record types are passed to a generic handler.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:3BEC
name: invoke_handler_via_global_pointer
description: Calls a routine whose address is read from a global variable, then returns. No values are passed in or out.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:3C0A
name: wait_for_message_flag
description: Calls a handler routine, and while its result is zero it waits on an exec message port and calls the handler again. It stops once the result is non-zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:3C36
name: dispatch_message_by_type
description: Fetches the next message through a handler and dispatches on its type word. The branches clear a pending value, store a source value, split a 16-bit word into three bit fields and append a record to a list, or store a pointer into globals.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:3C3A
name: dispatch_current_message_by_type
description: Dispatches the message held in a global pointer by its type word, using the same branches as the fetch-and-dispatch routine but without fetching a new message first.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:3DD0
name: copy_fields_and_call_routine
description: Copies a 32-bit value from offset 20 of its argument into a global variable, loads a routine pointer from offset 16 of the same argument, and calls that routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:3DE8
name: delay_by_packed_bitfield_counts
description: Splits an input 16-bit register value into three bit fields and runs an empty countdown loop for each non-zero field. It touches no memory and returns no value.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:3E38
name: copy_pointer_and_update_global
description: Stores the value at the second pointer argument into the first, and if the second pointer equals the global list head it makes the first pointer the new head. It then calls another routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:3E52
name: iterate_global_list_nodes
description: Walks a linked list that starts at a global head, calling a routine on each node and advancing to the node the routine returns. It returns zero when the list ends.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:3E68
name: read_global_record_field
description: Returns the 16-bit field at offset 120 of the record referenced by a global pointer, or minus one if that pointer is null.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:3E88
name: return_stored_word_value
description: Returns the 16-bit value held in a global variable without changing anything.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:3EC2
name: allocate_and_init_record
description: Stores a few globals and a pointer, then allocates a new record through an exec library call and fills its fields from the input value and the source record. On success it calls another routine and returns its result; on failure it scans forward for a marker byte and returns the offset found, or minus one.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4082
name: store_sentinel_and_call_library
description: Stores minus one into an output long, then calls two functions through library offsets. The two self-copy statements in the pseudo-code have no effect.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:411E
name: call_two_library_functions
description: Calls two Amiga OS library functions in sequence through jump offsets from the library base, then returns.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:414C
name: drain_queue_with_multitasking_off
description: Only runs when a global record pointer is set. It disables multitasking, replies to every message on a port, clears the global pointer, frees a resource through a library call, re-enables multitasking and returns the result of a further routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:41BC
name: lookup_entry_status_bits
description: Searches a global list for an entry of type eight whose key matches the current value, and returns status bits derived from that entry's low byte and high bit. When the list is empty it returns zero or a value computed from an input register.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:41E8
name: find_keyed_entry_status_bits
description: Clears a global value, then searches a global list for an entry of type eight whose key matches an input register. It returns status bits from that entry's low byte and high bit, or zero when nothing matches.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:421A
name: search_list_for_entry_flags
description: Walks a linked list from an input pointer looking for an entry of type eight whose key matches an input register. It returns status bits from that entry's low byte and high bit, or zero if the list ends first.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4220
name: decode_flag_byte
description: Reads a 16-bit word at offset 8 of an input record and returns flag bits: 4 when the high bit is set, 1 when the low seven bits equal 104, and 2 when they equal 105.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4252
name: match_cached_or_listed_entry
description: Returns quickly if a cached entry still matches the current key. Otherwise it walks a global list for an entry of type 1024 whose key matches and whose test routine succeeds, copies its three fields into globals and returns the test result, or minus one if nothing matches.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4292
name: find_listed_entry_for_key
description: Walks a global list for an entry of type 1024 whose key matches the current value and whose test routine succeeds. It copies three fields of that entry into globals and returns the test result, or minus one if no entry matches.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:42D2
name: search_list_for_matching_entry
description: Walks a linked list from an input pointer for an entry of type 1024 that matches an input key and passes a test routine. On success it copies three fields into globals and returns the result, and it returns minus one when the list ends.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:42D8
name: retry_entry_scan_until_match
description: Calls a test routine, and if it succeeds copies three fields from the matched entry into globals. Otherwise it repeatedly advances through a list for an entry of type 1024 that matches a global key and retries. It returns minus one when the list ends.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:430E
name: return_constant_minus_one
description: Returns a 32-bit minus one. The pseudo-code shows no other work.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:47B0
name: translate_character_with_case_flags
description: Stores the input value OR-ed with a fixed mask into an output location, then looks up the low byte in a table chosen by the flag bits. It shifts the character to upper or lower case when the flags ask for it and returns the adjusted value.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:47B4
name: map_character_through_selected_table
description: Stores the input value OR-ed with a fixed mask into an output location, then looks up the low byte in a table chosen by the flag bits. It adjusts the case when the flags ask for it and returns the adjusted value.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:47CC
name: store_masked_then_map_character
description: Stores the input value OR-ed with a fixed mask into an output location, then looks up the low byte in a table chosen by the flag bits. It adjusts the case when the flags ask for it and returns the adjusted value.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:47D4
name: translate_character_with_mode_bits
description: Stores the input value OR-ed with a fixed mask into an output location, then looks up the low byte in a table chosen by the flag bits. It adjusts the case when the flags ask for it and returns the adjusted value.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:48F4
name: stub_return_immediately
description: Contains no visible work and returns at once. The pseudo-code has no reads, writes or calls.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4916
name: convert_character_code_via_library
description: Maps values from 76 to 79 by subtracting 48 and values from 80 to 89 by adding 49, and maps 95 to 139 directly. Other inputs are stored with a parameter into globals and passed to a library function, and a byte from a global is returned when that call succeeds.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4980
name: open_console_and_init_tables
description: Clears a block of words and sets a few fields, then allocates a signal, finds the current task and opens the console.device through exec library calls. It finishes by filling two byte tables with 105 entries each, calling a routine for every entry.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4A16
name: close_console_and_free_signal
description: Frees a signal through an exec library call at a fixed offset, then closes the device opened earlier through a second library call.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4A2E
name: return_input_byte_unchanged
description: Returns the byte passed in the low byte of the data register without changing it. No other work is visible.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4A5E
name: pass_through_input_byte
description: Returns the byte passed in the low byte of the data register unchanged. The pseudo-code has no other reads or writes.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4A72
name: return_input_byte_unmodified
description: Returns the byte passed in the low byte of the data register unchanged. The pseudo-code shows no other work.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4AC8
name: push_handler_to_ring_buffer
description: Initializes global counters through two library calls, then saves the previous handler pointer into a 16-entry ring buffer and installs a new handler. It advances the buffer index as well.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4B0C
name: push_handler_and_bump_counter
description: Initializes global counters through two library calls, then saves the previous handler pointer into a 16-entry ring buffer and installs a new handler. It advances the buffer index and increments a counter.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4B24
name: push_handler_after_library_calls
description: Makes two library calls to set up globals, then saves the previous handler pointer into a 16-entry ring buffer and installs a new handler. It advances the buffer index and increments a counter.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4B5E
name: call_library_and_decrement_result
description: Calls a function through a pointer read from a global library base and returns its result minus one, paired with the unchanged input register.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4B66
name: call_indirect_and_decrement_result
description: Calls a function through a pointer read from a global library base and returns its result minus one, paired with the unchanged input register.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4B8C
name: store_byte_then_call_indirect
description: Stores the low byte of the input data register into a global variable, then calls a library function through a fixed negative offset from a global base.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4BB0
name: call_indirect_library_entry
description: Calls a library function through a fixed negative offset from a global base and returns.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4BF6
name: swap_handler_into_ring_buffer
description: Stores the current global handler pointer into a 16-entry ring buffer, replaces it with the value passed in an address register, then advances the buffer index and increments a counter.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4C28
name: pop_pointer_from_ring_buffer
description: Decrements a counter, steps the ring buffer index back one entry, and loads the stored pointer from that slot into a global variable.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4C4C
name: push_handler_and_set_block
description: Saves the current handler pointer into a 16-entry ring buffer, then sets the handler pointer to the address of a global block. It advances the index and increments a counter.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4C50
name: push_handler_and_install_argument
description: Saves the current handler pointer into a 16-entry ring buffer slot, installs the pointer passed in an address register as the new handler, then advances the index and increments a counter.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4C82
name: restore_handler_from_ring_buffer
description: Decrements a counter, steps the ring buffer index back one entry, and restores the global handler pointer from the slot it points to.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4CC0
name: call_stored_handler_pointer
description: Calls the routine whose address is stored in the global handler pointer, then returns.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4D52
name: clear_counter_and_return_byte
description: Clears two global values and returns the input byte unchanged.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4D56
name: clear_handler_and_counter
description: Sets a global counter and the global handler pointer to zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4D64
name: store_word_into_global_pointer
description: Stores the 16-bit input register into a global variable. The pseudo-code shows no other work.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4F66
name: copy_numeric_format_string
description: Copies characters from a source string into an output buffer, limited by a count, and stops at a hash or zero character. It writes minus or plus signs depending on the sign of an input value, keeps periods, and skips commas that follow a space.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4FE4
name: save_restore_global_word
description: Saves a 16-bit global value, sets it to zero, calls another routine, and then restores the saved value.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:4FFA
name: chain_three_routine_calls
description: Calls one routine, passes its return value to a second routine, then calls a third routine. It returns the second routine's result.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:5022
name: format_number_into_text_field
description: Formats a number into a text buffer according to a 16-bit format descriptor. It places a sign, counts digits before and after the decimal point, pads with spaces or zeros, and inserts a decimal point where the descriptor asks for one.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:5078
name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two other routines one after the other. No arguments or results are handled here.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:5086
name: call_routine_count_times
description: Calls another routine once for each step of a count taken from an input register, using a short counter, and then returns.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:5094
name: format_number_with_long_descriptor
description: Formats a number into a text buffer according to a 32-bit format descriptor. It places a sign, counts digits before and after the decimal point, pads with spaces or zeros, and inserts a decimal point where the descriptor asks for one. A descriptor value of 7 returns early.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:5106
name: trim_number_text_zeros
description: Optionally places a decimal point before the end of a number string and removes trailing zeros back to it. It then skips leading zeros, and writes a single zero when nothing else remains.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:517A
name: format_value_as_decimal_text
description: Converts a value from an input register into a text string. It finds a decimal exponent from a power-of-ten table, produces digits by repeated subtraction, and writes either a fixed-point or an exponent form with trailing zeros removed.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:5516
name: skip_leading_zeros
description: Gets a string pointer from another routine and advances past consecutive zero characters. If the string is then empty, it writes a zero character into the position before the terminator.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:5530
name: convert_integer_to_ascii
description: Writes the decimal digits of an input number into a buffer, working backwards from its end for a count of positions given in a second register. Each digit is the remainder after division by ten, written as a character.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:556E
name: convert_signed_integer_to_string
description: Converts a signed integer from a register into a null-terminated decimal string in a global buffer. It writes a minus sign for negative values, finds each digit by repeated subtraction of powers of ten, skips leading zeros, and writes a single zero for the value zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:55DA
name: close_library_base
description: Closes a library through a function call at a fixed offset from a global library base.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:55E4
name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero without any other work.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:55F4
name: copy_byte_buffer
description: Copies a given number of bytes from a source pointer to a destination pointer. Blocks of eight bytes are copied first in an unrolled loop, and the remaining bytes are copied one at a time.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:5634
name: set_global_word_to_max
description: Stores the largest 16-bit unsigned value into a global variable and returns the address of this routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:5644
name: scan_backwards_for_char
description: Scans backwards through a buffer from an end position, one byte at a time, until it finds the input character. It returns the index where the scan stopped, which is zero when no match is found.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:567C
name: fill_bytes_with_space
description: Clamps an input length to zero or more and subtracts a stored width from it. When the difference is positive it writes that many space characters into a buffer, then returns the clamped length.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:56A6
name: fit_text_into_field_width
description: Clamps a length, then copies text within a buffer to fit a stored field width. A shorter length copies the trailing part of the text to the front, and a longer one moves the text to the end of the field and fills the gap with spaces.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:56E2
name: copy_trailing_bytes_to_buffer
description: Copies a number of bytes from a source buffer, starting at the input count before a given end offset, into the destination. Larger counts use an eight-byte unrolled loop, and remaining bytes are copied singly.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:56EE
name: center_text_in_field
description: Lays out a text field from a buffer. When the field is wider than the text it pads spaces on both sides, and when it is narrower it copies the centre part of the text.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:57EA
name: copy_buffer_tail_to_output
description: Clamps a requested length and, if it is smaller than the stored size, copies that many bytes from the end of a buffer into the destination. Otherwise it returns the stored size without copying.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:5A66
name: copy_bytes_to_buffer
description: Grows a managed buffer through an indirect allocation call when it is missing or too small, then copies the input bytes into it in eight-byte blocks followed by single bytes. It finishes by writing a zero terminator.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:5AE8
name: return_zero_immediately
description: Returns zero without any other work.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:5AEC
name: compare_byte_strings
description: Compares two byte sequences one byte at a time. It returns minus one when the first sequence's byte is smaller at the first difference, one when it is larger, and zero when the bytes match, with a length check at the end.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:5B52
name: retry_open_library_until_success
description: Repeatedly calls an exec library function at a fixed offset, which opens exec.library, and retries until it returns a non-zero value. Each pass repeats a store that changes nothing.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom->HD:0:5B68
name: close_library_via_offset
description: Closes a library through a function call at a fixed offset from a global library base, then returns.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0000
name: run_program_entry_point
description: Program entry point. When a flag is clear it waits for and fetches a message, and otherwise it copies command text up to a newline if the first character is an at sign. It then opens libraries, runs setup calls, and if a counter exceeds a threshold it runs an endless service loop.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0006
name: build_linked_block_chain
description: Initializes a list header to point to itself, then links a series of blocks taken from a routine, spaced by a fixed step. The count and step come from input registers.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:003C
name: run_setup_and_service_loop
description: Runs the same startup logic as the program entry point: it reads a message or copies command text, runs setup calls, and when a counter passes a threshold it enters an endless service loop.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:007C
name: start_service_loop_with_setup
description: Runs the same startup logic as the program entry point: it reads a message or copies command text, runs setup calls, and when a counter passes a threshold it enters an endless service loop.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0080
name: run_startup_and_service_loop
description: Startup routine that reads a message or copies command text, runs setup calls and dos and exec library calls, and when a timer value passes a threshold it enters an endless service loop. It also writes the interrupt enable register.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:01F0
name: swap_two_global_longs
description: Exchanges two 32-bit global variables with each other.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0204
name: store_constants_and_copy_global
description: Stores the constants 6 and 8 into two global variables, then copies one global value into another.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0220
name: store_alternate_constants_and_copy
description: Stores the constants 8 and 10 into two global variables, then copies a different global value into another global variable.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:023C
name: encode_four_word_flags
description: Builds a flag value from four 16-bit fields of a record. The first field sets 1 or 2 by its sign, the second sets 4 or 8 by its sign, and the third and fourth set 16 and 32 when they are non-zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0276
name: decode_four_word_flags
description: Writes four 16-bit fields of a record from a flag value. The first and second fields become minus one, one or zero from two bits each, and the third and fourth become minus one or zero from one bit each.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0362
name: install_interrupt_vectors_then_loop
description: Calls the SetIntVector library function through a fixed offset four times, then calls another routine four times in a loop.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:03BA
name: store_three_fields_and_double
description: Clears a record word, stores three input values into other fields of the same record, and returns the first input value doubled.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:03D4
name: set_int_vector_four_calls
description: Calls the SetIntVector library function through a fixed offset four times in sequence.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:040E
name: service_table_until_empty
description: Repeatedly calls a routine, then scans four table records eight words apart for a non-zero first word. It repeats while a non-zero entry is found and returns when the scan finds none.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0428
name: insert_entry_into_priority_table
description: Looks for a free record in a four-entry global table and fills it with two input values and a pointer. If none is free, it replaces the first record whose priority word is lower than the new priority, then calls a routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:046A
name: program_audio_channel_registers
description: Writes the location, length and volume registers of one audio channel: the location comes from a register, the length is set to one word and the volume to zero. The channel offset comes from a record field, and two record values are then copied into a global.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:04A4
name: start_audio_channel_playback
description: Sets the request word in a record, then writes the period, length and volume registers of an audio channel and sets its location register from a pointer. It also copies three record values into globals, marking two of them with the top bit.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:04EA
name: reset_counter_and_call_routine
description: If a counter in the record is minus one, it resets the counter to zero and calls a routine. It then copies a field from the record into a global and returns zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:050A
name: run_status_dispatch_loop
description: Dispatches on a status value returned by a helper. Codes one to three each call a helper, codes four and five advance counters that wrap at two, and any other value sets a flag and leaves the loop. When the loop ends it restores saved pointers and returns a 16-bit result.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0690
name: call_routine_with_optional_second
description: Calls one routine, then calls a second routine only when a flag global is non-zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:06B2
name: call_sequence_with_flag_branches
description: Calls a fixed sequence of routines, making extra calls in two places only when a flag global is non-zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:06D4
name: compute_display_window_geometry
description: Calculates the centred offset and per-unit size of a display window from a mode value and a flag, then stores four values into a record. The width is clamped to a maximum, and a mode of two triggers an extra routine call first.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:06F6
name: compute_window_geometry_from_mode
description: Calculates the centred offset and per-unit size of a display window from a mode value and a flag, then stores four values into a record. The width is clamped to a maximum, and no extra routine is called.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0702
name: call_sequence_with_optional_pairs
description: Calls a fixed sequence of routines, making extra calls in two places only when a flag global is non-zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0724
name: compute_scaled_window_geometry
description: Computes the centred position and per-unit size of a display window from a mode value, a scale factor and a flag, then stores four values in a record. Width and height are clamped to limits that depend on the mode, and the height is forced to a fixed value when the flag is set.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:07F6
name: call_sequence_with_flag_pairs
description: Calls a fixed sequence of routines, making extra calls in two places only when a flag global is non-zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0814
name: run_copper_routine_sequence
description: Calls a fixed sequence of routines, including a start-copper-list routine that points the copper at a new list. It makes two extra calls only when a flag global is non-zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0884
name: toggle_mode_and_recompute_geometry
description: Flips the lowest bit of a mode value, stores it in two record fields, and recomputes the window offset and size from the stored geometry.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:08A8
name: check_vertical_position_window
description: If a pending flag is set and the current vertical position value is outside a stored range, it clears the flag, calls a routine, and copies a 32-bit result into a record. It returns the high part of that result.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:08E6
name: call_two_then_halt_loop
description: Calls two routines in sequence and then loops forever without returning.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:08F2
name: wait_for_flags_then_sequence
description: Spins until a global flag is set and clears it, then spins until a second flag is clear. It calls a few routines, optionally runs a second group, and sets a pending flag before returning a 16-bit result.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0952
name: reset_record_fields_to_defaults
description: Clears a group of word fields in a record, sets a byte field and two word fields to all ones, and stores the address of a global block in a pointer field.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:09A8
name: process_text_string_characters
description: Walks a text string from a record pointer to its terminator. For each character that is not a space it calls a routine a number of times set by a counter, and it returns the last routine result.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:09BA
name: process_text_characters_from_register
description: Walks a text string from an address register to its terminator. For each character that is not a space it calls routines a number of times set by a counter, starting from a value in an input register, and returns the last result.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0A5C
name: program_blitter_from_record_entry
description: Computes blitter register values from a record's position and size and a table entry, waits for the blitter to be idle, then writes those values to the blitter registers.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0A90
name: start_blitter_rectangle_copy
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, then writes its control, mask, modulo and pointer registers from a record. The source address is computed from a row offset of 280 bytes per row, and a fixed-size blit is started.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0AF0
name: emit_eight_rotated_nibble_calls
description: Sets bits in a word of a record, then makes eight calls to a routine. Between calls it rotates a 32-bit value left by four bits and advances a position value by six.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0B36
name: call_routine_by_record_counts
description: Calls a routine once for each step up to a count from a record field, raising that count to at least 25 first. If another record field is non-zero it makes that many extra calls, then calls the routine five more times.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0BE2
name: program_blitter_with_shift_offset
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, then sets its control registers from a shift value, its masks, and its source and destination pointers. The address is computed from a table entry and a row offset of 280 bytes.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0CE8
name: fill_scanline_from_lookup_table
description: Fills a buffer of 16-bit values for scanline positions by stepping an index through a scaled table and copying entries from a lookup table. It then clears the rest of the buffer with zeros, and does nothing when a control value equals 256.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0D84
name: draw_scaled_row_pixels
description: Computes a per-row step by dividing a scaled value by an input count, looks up source pointers through two tables, and writes masked 16-bit values into a buffer while stepping along it. It stops early when the index is zero or out of range.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0D88
name: draw_scaled_row_alternate_entry
description: Runs the same scaled row-drawing logic as its neighbour: it divides a scaled value, looks up source pointers and writes masked values into a buffer, stopping early when the index is zero or out of range.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0D8C
name: draw_scaled_row_with_calls
description: Runs the same scaled row-drawing logic as its neighbours: it divides a scaled value, looks up source pointers and writes masked values into a buffer. It also calls three helper routines.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0EB6
name: rotate_countdown_table_entries
description: Walks a table of four-word entries that ends at a zero word. Each entry's counter decrements, and when it reaches zero the counter is reloaded and a run of 32-bit entries from a routine table is shifted down by one, with the first entry moved to the end.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0EE6
name: update_linked_object_positions
description: Walks a linked list of objects and skips those with zero velocity. For each active object it adds the velocity to a position value and writes pairs of coordinate values into a buffer of 32-byte entries, calling helpers for the values.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:0FF2
name: normalize_two_components
description: Computes the squared length of a two-component vector and scales it down by repeated halving until it fits a table range. It then divides both components by the larger of their magnitudes and returns the two scaled results.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:106E
name: multiply_two_by_two_terms
description: Computes two sums of products from four 16-bit values read through two pointers, forming one row and one column of a 2 by 2 matrix product. Both results are rotated and scaled into 32-bit values.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:1092
name: interpolate_record_list_coordinates
description: Walks a linked list of records, advancing each record's fraction and interpolating four coordinate values between start and end points. Records whose fraction reaches zero or the full scale value are moved onto a free list.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:1128
name: update_palette_record_list
description: Takes the record list selected by an input index and moves records between free and active lists, linking each one in a fixed order. It writes the background colour register and a second display control register.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:119C
name: process_palette_record_stream
description: Reads a stream of records, each with a type word, and handles them by type. Type one moves records between linked lists, and other records write a byte value into a per-slot table.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:127E
name: insert_entry_with_fixed_priority
description: Looks for a free record in a four-entry table and fills it with a fixed priority of ten, a fixed value of 64 and a pointer. If none is free it replaces the first record with a priority below ten, then calls a routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:129A
name: lazy_fill_indexed_record_fields
description: Looks up a record by an index, and calls a helper to fill its first field when that field is empty. For its second field it writes the digit two at the end of a text string, calls a helper, then restores the terminator.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:14A8
name: store_offset_sum_in_record
description: Calls a routine to get a value, adds it to a field of the current record, and stores the sum in another field of that record.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:14BA
name: fill_table_with_lcg_sequence
description: Fills a 55-entry global table of 16-bit values with a linear congruential sequence: each value is the previous one multiplied by 7933 and increased by 3583, starting from the input value. It then stores the table end pointer in a global.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:14E0
name: accumulate_into_ring_pointer
description: Steps two pointers backwards through a circular buffer of 16-bit values, adds the value read through one pointer into the value at the other, and wraps each pointer back to the far end when it passes the start.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:1586
name: combine_two_calls_into_long
description: Calls two routines and returns a 32-bit value whose upper word is the second call's 16-bit result and whose lower word is an input register word.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:158A
name: pack_call_result_with_input
description: Calls two routines and packs the second routine's 16-bit result into the upper half of a 32-bit return value, with an input register word in the lower half.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:159E
name: multiply_call_result_by_word
description: Calls a routine to get a value, multiplies its low 16 bits by an input word, and returns the 32-bit product with its two halves swapped.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:15AA
name: fill_secondary_table_with_lcg
description: Fills a second 55-entry global table of 16-bit values with the same linear congruential sequence, multiplying by 7933 and adding 3583 each step. It then stores the table end pointer in a global.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:15D0
name: accumulate_into_second_ring_pointer
description: Steps two pointers backwards through a second circular buffer of 16-bit values, adds the value read through one pointer into the value at the other, and wraps each pointer back to the far end when it passes the start.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:1676
name: pack_call_result_with_register
description: Calls two routines and packs the second routine's 16-bit result into the upper half of a 32-bit return value, with an input register word in the lower half.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:167A
name: scale_call_result_by_word
description: Calls a routine to get a value, multiplies its low 16 bits by an input word, and returns the 32-bit product with its two halves swapped.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:168E
name: pack_result_from_second_call
description: Calls two routines and packs the second routine's 16-bit result into the upper half of a 32-bit return value, with an input register word in the lower half.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:169A
name: compute_line_octant_slope
description: Computes the absolute horizontal and vertical differences between two global points and a record's point, works out the octant from their signs and ordering, and looks up a slope value from a table. It returns the octant bits and slope packed into a 32-bit value.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:16AC
name: compute_line_octant_between_records
description: Computes the octant and slope between the points of two records from their horizontal and vertical differences. It returns the octant bits with a slope value packed into a 32-bit result.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:16DC
name: lookup_slope_from_quotient
description: Divides a 16-bit value by a count to form an index into a slope table, returning zero when the count is zero. It packs the looked-up value with an entry from a second table into a 32-bit result.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:16EA
name: lookup_slope_entry_by_ratio
description: Computes an index into a slope table from the ratio of two input words, and returns a packed value that combines that entry with a value from a second table.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:1B28
name: run_record_list_pass
description: Stores several fields of a record into globals, then walks a linked list of records and calls a handler on each one except the current record. Records with a flag set get a temporary global around the call, and a second walk makes further calls.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:1B2C
name: walk_record_list_with_handlers
description: Stores several record fields into globals, writes a control value at the start and end, and walks a linked list of records calling handler routines. It then walks the list a second time.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:1BD8
name: service_record_event_flags
description: Clears the top bit of a flag byte in a record, and if it was set clears the top bit of a second flag byte and calls routines accordingly. For a signed word counter, minus one resets it to zero and calls a routine, while other negative values are negated before two calls.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:1C26
name: copy_clipped_blocks_to_buffer
description: Calls several helpers, then copies rows of 16-bit words between two tables in blocks. Each block's length is clipped to limits held in globals, and the loop runs until the remaining length is used up.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:1C88
name: advance_frame_counter_and_call
description: When a flag is set, advances a stored pointer and calls routines, then decrements a counter and calls a routine while it is non-zero. It returns that routine's result, or zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:1CEA
name: tick_countdowns_and_dispatch
description: Decrements four countdown timers in a table and calls a routine each time one reaches zero. It then checks a global counter and calls one of two routines, subtracting 128 from the counter when it is large, or resetting it to zero otherwise.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:1D50
name: dispatch_command_or_wait
description: Looks up a command routine from a table by a record field and calls it. A negative field waits on a status flag and repeats a routine until it clears, while otherwise a byte result is saved in a 128-entry ring buffer and decoded into four 16-bit fields.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:1DA8
name: wait_flag_then_store_status
description: Waits for a status bit to be set and then clears it, reads a status word, and stores its low seven bits in a global when its top bit is set. It also copies two words from a record into globals.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:1DFC
name: dispatch_command_when_idle
description: When two status globals are both zero, it sets a flag from a record and calls a routine. It then dispatches a command the same way as its neighbour: waiting on a status flag for negative fields, or calling a table routine and saving a byte in a 128-entry ring buffer.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:1E30
name: resolve_linked_object_collisions
description: Updates two counters in a record, then if a flag is set walks a linked list of other records. It compares horizontal and vertical distances against their sizes to detect overlaps, and calls handlers for the records that overlap.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:1F54
name: stub_return_without_work
description: Returns at once. The pseudo-code contains no other work.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:1F66
name: call_stored_routine_pointer
description: Calls the routine whose address is stored in a global variable, then returns.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:1F6C
name: insert_object_and_check_overlaps
description: Moves a record onto the head of a global list, then walks the list calling a handler for each record with a flag and checking overlaps against records whose flag bits match. It returns zero once the list is finished.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:1F94
name: insert_object_with_timed_handler
description: Moves a record onto the head of a global list and decrements a timer field, then selects a handler from the record depending on whether the timer has reached zero. It walks the list the same way as its neighbour, checking overlaps and calling handlers.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:1FBA
name: scale_call_result_by_four
description: Calls a routine to get a 16-bit value and returns it multiplied by four.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:1FC4
name: scale_result_by_thirty_two
description: Calls a routine to get a 16-bit value and returns it multiplied by 32.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:1FCE
name: scale_call_result_by_sixteen
description: Calls a routine to get a 16-bit value and returns it multiplied by 16.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:1FD8
name: spawn_records_from_free_list
description: Takes records from a free list one at a time, moves each onto an active list, and sets its position from fields of the caller's record along with its handler pointers and a counter. It calls helpers for the initial values and returns when the free list is empty.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:206C
name: advance_record_position_by_velocity
description: Decrements a step counter in a record. While the counter stays positive and non-zero it adds three velocity values to the record's position, and otherwise it calls a stored handler.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:208E
name: spawn_records_with_offsets
description: Computes three base values with helper calls, then for each record in a count takes one from a free list and sets its three position fields from the bases plus record offsets and a stored word.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2100
name: spawn_records_from_offset_pool
description: Computes three base values with helper calls, then for each record in a count takes one from a free list and sets its three position fields from the bases plus record offsets and a stored word.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2172
name: step_position_with_fraction_carry
description: Adds a fixed fraction to an accumulator in a record and checks the carry against the sign of the result. On overflow it updates two position fields by their velocities, and otherwise it moves records between lists and calls helpers.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2228
name: set_position_and_reset_velocity
description: Stores an input value into a record field and calls a routine. When that value was non-zero it clears two velocity fields in the record.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:223C
name: step_fraction_or_handle
description: Adds a fixed fraction to an accumulator in a record. On carry-out it calls a stored handler, and otherwise it adds two velocity values to two position fields.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2252
name: add_velocity_to_two_positions
description: Adds two stored velocity values to two position fields of a record.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2262
name: insert_entry_with_minimum_priority
description: Looks for a free record in a four-entry table and fills it with a priority of minus one, a value of 32 and a pointer. If none is free it replaces the first record whose priority is below minus one, then calls a routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:226E
name: dispatch_by_field_then_handler
description: Calls two routines, then calls one of two others depending on whether a record field is zero, and finally calls the routine whose address is stored in a global variable.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:227E
name: initialize_record_handlers_and_counter
description: Calls nine helper routines, then installs two handler pointers in a record, clears two fields and sets a counter field to 127.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:22E8
name: countdown_and_flag_on_expiry
description: Decrements a counter in a record and, when the counter reaches zero or was already not positive, sets a global value to three.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:22F8
name: release_owner_and_dispatch
description: If the record is the one held by two globals, clears those globals. It then calls routines, calls one of two more depending on a record field, and finally calls the stored handler.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:230A
name: dispatch_record_field_branch
description: Calls two routines, then calls one of two others depending on whether a record field is zero, and finally calls the routine whose address is stored in a global variable.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:232C
name: call_routine_then_stored_handler
description: Calls one routine, then calls the routine whose address is stored in a global variable.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2336
name: spawn_fixed_records_from_pool
description: Takes records from a free list for a count read from a record field, sets each one's fields from the caller's values and a fixed constant, and calls helpers. When the list runs out it calls the stored handler.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:23D6
name: claim_record_for_timed_effect
description: When no owner is held, claims a record by saving its values and installing temporary handler pointers with a counter of 64. Each step decrements the counter, and when it expires the saved values are restored and the record is released.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:241A
name: stub_empty_handler
description: Returns at once without any work.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:241C
name: step_counter_restore_on_expiry
description: Decrements a counter in a record. On expiry it restores saved fields, clears the owner globals and sets a field from a helper result. Otherwise it stores a helper value and computes a table address from it.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:244E
name: store_helper_value_and_index
description: Stores a helper routine's 16-bit result in a record field, computes a table address from its low byte, and then calls a routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:247A
name: spawn_scaled_records_into_pool
description: Takes records from a free list in a loop, moves each onto an active list, and sets its position fields from values in the caller's record scaled by 32, with a table-derived offset added. It calls helpers for each offset and returns when the free list is empty.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:247E
name: spawn_scaled_records_from_source
description: Takes records from a free list in a loop, moves each onto an active list, and sets its position fields from values in the caller's record scaled by 32, with a table-derived offset added. It calls helpers for each offset and returns when the free list is empty.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2482
name: populate_scaled_records_from_pool
description: Takes records from a free list in a loop, moves each onto an active list, and sets its position fields from values in the caller's record scaled by 32, with a table-derived offset added. It calls helpers for each offset and returns when the free list is empty.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2486
name: spawn_scaled_records_from_list
description: Takes records from a free list in a loop, moves each onto an active list, and sets its position fields from values in the caller's record scaled by 32, with a table-derived offset added. It calls helpers for each offset and returns when the free list is empty.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2530
name: call_single_routine_passthrough
description: Calls one routine and returns without any other work.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2538
name: start_timed_handler_if_idle
description: Calls a routine, then if two status bits in a record are clear, calls another routine and copies a counter into a second field. When the counter is non-zero it sets a state value to four, saves the two handler pointers and replaces them with new ones.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:254A
name: pick_selector_then_start_handler
description: Chooses a two-bit selector that differs from its previous value and stores it. It then calls a routine and performs the same status check and handler installation as its neighbour, saving the two handler pointers and replacing them with new ones.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:25B8
name: start_timed_handler_when_clear
description: Calls a routine, then if two status bits in a record are clear, calls another routine and copies a counter into a second field. When the counter is non-zero it sets a state value to four, saves the two handler pointers and replaces them with new ones.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:25CC
name: start_handler_on_clear_flags
description: Calls a routine, then if two status bits in a record are clear, calls another routine and copies a counter into a second field. When the counter is non-zero it sets a state value to four, saves the two handler pointers and replaces them with new ones.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:25E0
name: countdown_restore_saved_handlers
description: Decrements a counter in a record, and when it reaches zero or was not positive it clears a state value and restores the two handler pointers saved earlier.
